approvalContext: Direct approval of the independently reviewed R4 Whitefish identity delivery correction proposal, following the assistant explanation and request to authorize this exact prospective policy and delivery correction.
approvedProposalText:
# Proposed R4 Whitefish identity delivery correction

Status: proposal only. The user selected Whitefish Scholarship as the repository identity
and approved the supported owner-account retry. Both actions have been performed to their
available extent. This proposal does not claim authority to amend acceptance policy.

## Purpose and observed problem

Deliver the already reviewed411-award R3 runtime through the existing private GitHub
repository and Vercel Hobby project using its verified owner, whitefishscholarship.
The original release commit d6fdc0d0470dec199c6b93e2c0525b6eebe2e4e2 is attributed to
Franscale1922 and Vercel blocked it. After the user specifically approved an owner retry,
the supported Redeploy dialog still disabled deployment and offered only a Pro upgrade.
See owner-redeploy-result.json. No new deployment, account/access change or upgrade occurred.

Authenticated GitHub account is whitefishscholarship (ID266880911). Authenticated Vercel
links that same GitHub account. Delivered main's author is whitefishscholarship with email
whitefishscholarship@gmail.com. Repository-local Git author now uses that identity; global
settings are untouched. The published commit and its review cannot be edited in place.

The repository requires the first valid attestation to remain canonical and forbids any
later commit before its delivery. Therefore an ordinary identity-fixing commit would fail
the required checks. Recreating/rebinding that canonical attestation or force-pushing is
excluded. We need a single expressly selected continuation, preserving the original
attestation, with its own independent review and new owner-authored branch tip.

## Exact proposed scope

1. Preserve existing PR46 and branch codex/r4-catalog-release at original A18
   d6fdc0d0470dec199c6b93e2c0525b6eebe2e4e2. Preserve candidate C18
   5e5c140dc49250234438fa9b741064acc7aa8375, its tree, canonical manifest SHA256
   a5ec94957e50cecfea9c8aadd16792b98143e92bea3c5ba9f4c03e0705ce3360 and review SHA256
   2e4021edb28bcfc4431a2834c0b5027e35ac7d4e474fc61a4b7e8edb611ec4f4 byte-for-byte.
   All older canonical artifacts, R3 grants/reviews, failed timestamp attempt, original
   R1/R2 refs and applied257-operation no-replay controls remain unchanged.
2. On a new codex/r4-whitefish-delivery-repair branch descending from A18, prepare a
   dedicated prospective PLAN-REV19 identity-delivery continuation. Freshly verify main
   equals a8aa6f958f029b7edfacf03ac6c5848e9e8f4b32 before binding that baseline; if it has
   moved, stop and reassess rather than silently rebind. P0–P9/R1/R2 remain complete,
   R3 remains locally complete, and stage pointers remain null. This remains R4 delivery.
3. Preserve original REV18 amendment/grant objects. Record the new direct user selection,
   exact original A18, baseline, owner identity, target, allowed paths and effects in
   a new REV19 record and docs/evidence/PLAN-REV19.md. Independently review the frozen
   prospective policy before implementation. Policy preparation does not waive validation.
4. Add a narrowly pinned validation continuation that recognizes only a separately valid
   direct-child two-file REV19 attestation A19, whose candidate C19 descends from original
   A18. Only that A19 may be the allowed undelivered tip for preserved REV18. Before A19,
   require the original REV18 tip diagnostic plus the three missing REV19 artifacts;
   every other diagnostic remains blocking. After A19, require actual local and hosted
   validator modes both exit0. This is no general tip-lock, author or review exception.
5. Enforce byte preservation from A18 outside the finite allowlist below; preserve every
   historical manifest/review and the original REV18 amendment object. Verify both author
   and committer of new repair commits use the selected Whitefish identity; verify the
   published head is attributed by GitHub to whitefishscholarship before proceeding.
   During preparation, enforce this preservation on the active repair candidate. After
   acceptance, verify preservation against immutable C19/A19 Git trees, not the current
   working tree. Later separately authorized stages may evolve runtime/state normally;
   they must preserve historical C19/A19 proof rather than remain frozen to those trees.
6. Freeze a complete M0-to-C19 manifest including original A18 history and all new policy,
   code, tests, evidence and routing. Obtain fresh-context read-only full-candidate review
   with zero critical/high and count-matched dispositions. Add only the REV19 manifest
   and review as C19's immediate child. Keep A19 as branch tip until merged.
7. Use the already approved R4 publication/Preview/merge/Production/verification effects
   on the new branch and PR. Preserve PR46 and its branch as historical evidence; after
   the replacement PR exists, close PR46 unmerged with the replacement identified, never
   rewrite its head. Run CI and verify exact Preview before ancestry-preserving merge
   using an exact-head guard. Verify exact Production afterward. A continuing provider
   rejection remains a blocker; no alternative identity, paid plan or access change.

## Finite change allowlist

Existing paths that may change only for the selected continuation:
- AGENTS.md (document exact REV19 exception only)
- docs/SCHOLARSHIP_SYSTEM_BUILD_PLAN.md
- docs/BUILD_STATE.json
- docs/DECISIONS.md (append)
- docs/CURRENT_HANDOFF.md (new operative pointer; retain complete prior content)
- web/scripts/validate-build-plan.ts (invoke pinned continuation; preserve all other gates)
- web/package.json (append exact new regression test command only; no dependency change)

New paths:
- docs/evidence/PLAN-REV19.md
- docs/evidence/PLAN-REV19-manifest.json (attestation only)
- docs/reviews/PLAN-REV19.json (attestation only)
- docs/kickoffs/R4-WHITEFISH-DELIVERY.md
- web/scripts/r4-identity-delivery.ts
- web/scripts/test-r4-identity-delivery.ts
- docs/evidence/r4-identity-repair/authority.json
- docs/evidence/r4-identity-repair/preflight.json
- docs/evidence/r4-identity-repair/policy-manifest.json
- docs/evidence/r4-identity-repair/policy-review.json
- docs/evidence/r4-identity-repair/policy-validation.json
- docs/evidence/r4-identity-repair/preservation.json
- docs/evidence/r4-identity-repair/validation.json
- docs/evidence/r4-identity-repair/RELEASE_CANDIDATE.md

No product runtime, catalog, source evidence, fixture, lockfile, deployment configuration,
CI workflow or historical review artifact may change. Record post-attestation/hosted
observations outside the locked release branch until merged; then preserve them in a
separate local-only handoff. No additional unreviewed commit may be pushed for closeout.

## Required checks and stop conditions

Run plan:check, typecheck, full npm test, build, intake/coverage/R3 checks and P9 production
build-trace checks. Add meaningful negative tests rejecting changed original A18/baseline,
expanded allowlists, mutated original evidence/grants, missing authority/review, wrong
candidate ancestry, non-direct child or extra attestation paths, wrong owner identity and
any post-A19 undelivered tip. Add a regression showing a valid later separately authorized
stage can evolve its runtime/state after A19 delivery while historical C19/A19 checks
still pass; changed historical proofs must fail. Preserve existing tests and all prior
repair exceptions.

Recompute unchanged runtime and selected bundle hashes; existing independently reviewed
local browser evidence applies only to those exact bytes. Run exact hosted API, catalog,
compatibility, health/commit/source-capability, browser and public CSV checks. Hosted
request-body/download evidence unavailable through tooling remains unknown. No source
recapture, new scholarship verification or claims about current official award facts.

If the finite scope cannot be implemented without changing runtime, historical bindings,
account access or any additional acceptance rule, stop and return the exact new issue.
Do not use this correction as a general-purpose workaround for unrelated failed checks.

## Value and risk

Value: publish the already completed student improvements under the intended project
owner without purchasing collaboration access or changing the scholarship data.

Primary risk: making the release-validator exception too broad could allow unrelated
unreviewed work to pass. Fixed historical pins, a finite path allowlist, preserved original
review artifacts, negative tests, fresh independent reviews and zero actual final
validation prevent that scope expansion. Application/data behavior is unchanged.

## Decision requested after independent proposal review

Authorize only this R4 identity-delivery correction, including its narrowly pinned
prospective release-policy amendment and independent implementation/acceptance reviews.
The existing R4 publication/Preview/merge/Production grant continues for this same runtime
on the named replacement branch. No subscription purchase, account/access change, source
read/write, monitoring, rollback, provider interaction or R5–R7 execution is included.
